public_rationale: Marcus said AI is real and gave everyday examples, including navigation and web search. On 2024-10-29, Google said all seven of its products and platforms with more than 2 billion monthly users use Gemini models, and that this includes Google Maps (e1). On the same date, Google said AI Overviews in Search had started rolling out that week to more than a hundred new countries and territories, and would now reach more than 1 billion users a month (e2). These are 2024 company disclosures, made before the post date, showing AI built into widely used maps and search products. That meets the support condition. No item in the packet shows that these products lacked AI. A Pew survey fielded in December 2022 found that 27% of US adults said they interact with AI at least several times a day (e3). It comes before the 2024 window, so it is context only.
limitations: Marcus's own daily use cannot be checked and is not scored.
The 2024 evidence is one company's own statements and was not independently verified.
The 1 billion figure for AI Overviews is Google's statement of expected monthly reach after a rollout. It is not a measured 2024 user count.
The packet does not separately document AI in speech recognition or recommendation products in 2024.
